2022. Replace a Word in a Sentence

80

Hard

Problem Statement

Given a sentence, an old word, and a new word, replace all occurrences of the old word with the new word.

Input

Sentence
Old Word
New Word

Output

Print the modified sentence.

samples.input:
Java is easy and Java is powerful
Java
Python
samples.output: Python is easy and Python is powerful
